content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation combines document retrieval with LLM generation. Core steps are ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, and grounded response generation.
LLM agents use a language model to plan tasks, select tools, execute actions, observe results, and continue until the task is complete.
Model Context Protocol standardizes how AI applications discover and call external tools and resources through MCP servers.
AI system observability includes logs, metrics, traces, latency, token usage, errors, and evaluation signals.
Effective prompts define the role, context, constraints, expected output format, and grounding requirements.
